notes: Original p. 4 contains multiple tests; extracted the cold-versus-warm loneliness planned comparison, matching the replication primary contrast. Original pairwise analytic n is not explicitly printed and is left null rather than derived from df; 75 is the recruited sample across three conditions. Replication p. 4 corresponds to printed p. 16. Replication d = .02 and t(258) = −0.006 are retained exactly as printed despite their apparent inconsistency; no conversion or repair performed. Replication full paper obtained as HTML transcription of the published article, title/authors/DOI verified, with overlapping web-rendered sections cached.
